title: Decode remote bytes
responsibility: Decode base64 and verify its declared byte length and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: remoteBinary.value
inputs.description: The media a computer sent: encoding must be exactly 'base64', data is its base64 text, byteLength must equal the number of bytes that text decodes to, and sha256 must equal the lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of those bytes. Any other encoding, non-string data, undecodable base64, or a length or hash mismatch makes remoteBinary reject instead of returning bytes.

outputs.name: unreadableMedia
outputs.description: The exported message that remoteBinary uses as the message of the Error it throws for an encoding other than 'base64', non-string data, or undecodable base64. It is never returned as a value, so it reaches a caller only as that Error's message.
examples: The computer sent media this app cannot read.

outputs.name: damagedMedia
outputs.description: The exported message that remoteBinary uses as the message of the Error it throws when the decoded byte count differs from byteLength or the SHA-256 hex differs from sha256. It is never returned as a value, so it reaches a caller only as that Error's message.
examples: The media arrived damaged and is not shown.

outputs.name: remoteBinary
outputs.description: Resolves to a new Uint8Array holding one byte per character that atob returns for data. It resolves only after the decoded length equals byteLength and the SHA-256 digest equals sha256; otherwise the promise rejects.

errors.name: Unreadable or damaged remote binary
errors.description: Thrown inside the async remoteBinary, so callers receive a rejected promise: with the unreadableMedia message for an encoding other than 'base64', non-string data, or undecodable base64, and with the damagedMedia message for a decoded length or SHA-256 mismatch. Failures from crypto.subtle.digest are not caught, so they also reject the promise.
